messages:
sam: Quick handoff — I'm signing off in 30m, handing to @jess. Key context: yesterday's postmortem (link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PR-482) covered the KV-cache eviction bug and the rolling rollback we did. I ran the basic verification but leaving a small checklist for you:
- confirm canary latency is stable
- run the smoke write/read to kv cache
- double-check dedicated-customer A's request routing
If anything looks off please reopen INC-482. I'm leaving my notes below. :wave:

jess: Thanks — grabbing it. Can you paste the exact smoke commands you used? Also which grafana dashboard to watch for 5xx/latency?

sam: Sure — smoke commands I ran locally (from infra box):
```
# check canary
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN' \
  'https://canary.redwood/api/v1/health?model=redwood-3' | jq .status
# kv read/write
python scripts/kv_smoke.py --key oncall-check --value test123
```
Dashboards: infra -> inference-overview, and infra -> kv-cache-metrics (filter by cluster: canary).

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: sam -> jess (scheduled at 1967771800). Reminder: if reopen requested, add "reopen: true" to the thread.

mike: FYI — canary hosts show slight spike earlier this morning, but the canary-run that's live now has 0.12% 5xx, latency p95 ~ 220ms. Not seeing the 0.6% spike anymore. Pasted last 30m: 5xx_rate=0.12%; p95=220ms.

anya: Quick note — dedicated-customer A reported increased error rate yesterday around the rollback window. They opened a support ticket but we told them rollback completed. If we re-open INC-482 we should proactively CC their PM.

jess: Ok I'll run the kv smoke and confirm routing. If I see >0.3% 5xx on dedicated cluster I'll open the incident. Running smoke now...

jess: smoke result: write OK, read OK, no obvious data mismatch. Running a small load test (50rps) against canary for 3m.

mike: If you want a quick read, watch this curl-based health check every 10s: `while true; do curl -s https://canary.redwood/api/v1/health | jq .errors; sleep 10; done`

jess: load test completed: 3m at 50rps, 5xx_rate=0.14%, p95=230ms. Steady. I'm going to mark the KV-cache remediation verification as "in-progress" in the postmortem tracker.

sam: Awesome. One small follow-up: the postmortem checklist had a DB migration that we delayed. The PR that touches the routing table is merged but the migration flag is off in prod. Can you confirm we didn't forget to schedule it? PR #789 is blocked behind the migration flag.

jess: Checking PR #789 — looks like feature-flag=off in prod config. I'll coordinate with releases to schedule the migration early next week unless we want it now.

anya: For customer A: I'll ping PM and let them know we're watching and will reopen if metrics cross threshold. Also adding a short note to the support ticket about the planned migration.

jess: OK — unless we see new spikes I'm going to close this handoff as "stable" in ~45m. If anyone sees >0.3% 5xx for 15m straight please call the on-call number and reopen INC-482. :phone: :warning:

oncall-bot: Reminder: if handoff completes, react with :white_check_mark:.
